summary_ja: 内部格付制度及び推計値を検証する頑健な制度の整備を定める。
summary_en: Requires a robust system for validating the internal rating system, its operation, and the accuracy and consistency of PD, LGD and EAD estimates.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall establish a robust system for validating the internal rating system and its operation, and the accuracy and consistency of the estimates of PD, LGD and EAD.

sections_en.第四節 第六款: Validation of the Internal Rating System and Estimates
